'''Ott Klemp''' was a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] who served in the [[Scavenger Squadron]] around [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].

==Biography==
Ott Klemp was one of the younger and less experienced pilots of the [[Scavenger Squadron]]. [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Gennad Rozhdenst]] assigned Klemp the duty of transferring him from their mobile base-support ship to the [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|KDY]] construction docks, to give the young pilot more flight time.
Klemp was able to share with his [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] his belief that [[Scavenger Squadron]] should try to claim the completed [[Warship/Legends|Warships]] that awaited the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] on the [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|KDY]] construction docks. [[Gennad Rozhdenst|Rozhdenst]] explained that the poorly equipped squadron would fail in that attempt.

During the attempted destruction of the construction docks at [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|KDY]] by [[Kuat of Kuat/Legends|Kuat of Kuat]], Ott Klemp and the [[Scavenger Squadron]] did try to save these warships. Klemp flew his [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-Wing]] down to the dock, transferred into a [[Tug module]] connected to a [[Lancer-class frigate/Legends|Lancer-class frigate]] and successfully piloted it below a falling construction crane to safety.

[[Scavenger Squadron]] was able to save four [[Lancer-class frigate/Legends|Lancer-class frigates]] and an unspecified number of [[Zebulon-B frigate]]s. Unfortunately, [[Scavenger Squadron]] lost 2 pilots during the mission.
